task.description: WF-03 Step 6 RELEASE-VALIDATOR (.claude/agents/release-validator.md): independently re-derive acceptance, trust nothing from the step-03 report. Acceptance: (1) start_pool!/2 checks current_database() against the configured test database and raises BEFORE it provisions or resets anything; (2) a test asserts the refusal on a name mismatch; (3) a mutation (guard removed) makes the refusal test fail; (4) no change to reset semantics when the guard passes. DO YOURSELF (one mix invocation at a time under the mutex, throwaway postgres:16 on 5499, remove it afterwards): run the new describe 'ISS-1061 database guard' and the whole test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs + test/support/tenant_fixture_dispatch_test.exs, quote counts; apply mutant M1 (delete the guard call in start_pool!/2) to the working tree, run the describe, confirm T4 fails, git checkout the file to restore, and confirm the tree is clean; apply M2b (guard after create_slots) the same way if time allows; verify mix format --check-formatted and git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD only lists the expected files; verify `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` is clean. Report real output. Q-1054 / GH #2400 (queue ref ISS-1054, local record docs/issues/ISS-1061.yaml), branch feature/WF03-ISS1054DBGUARD-20261012, implementation commit c4944af4a (step 03 handoff). Change: test/support/tenant_fixture.ex adds assert_test_database!/1 (expected name from Repo.config()[:database], letflow_test* prefix check, current_database() equality, ArgumentError, fail closed), called in start_pool!/2 after Sandbox.mode(:auto) and before GenServer.start/create_slots, plus defense in depth in Pool.init/1; new :expected_database test seam; tests T1..T5 in test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs; test/specs/ISS-1061.md; one paragraph in lib/letflow/design/iss1042-pooled-tenant-fixture.md. Compare with `git diff origin/main...HEAD`. Design: step-01 and validator step-02b handoffs under handoffs/WF03-ISS1054DBGUARD-20261012/. No mix needed (all gates already ran; if you want to run any mix use the mutex: L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd /c/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow && LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test <ONE mix invocation>, with a throwaway postgres:16 on 5499 you remove afterwards). Foreground only, no Monitors. Result into your handoff (COMPLETED, result.status PASS/FAIL, no BOM, LF, no self-reference in artifacts_out); pull --rebase, commit, push with bounded retry; message ends 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. Concurrent sibling gate writes another handoff on this branch: pull --rebase before push.

result.summary: RELEASE-VALIDATOR PASS. Independently re-run on a throwaway postgres:16 (port 5499, removed afterwards), one mix invocation at a time under the mutex. (a) tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs + tenant_fixture_dispatch_test.exs: 'Result: 78 passed (1 property, 77 tests)', exit 0. (b) describe 'ISS-1061 database guard': 'Result: 5 passed, 62 excluded'. (c) Mutant M1 (guard call deleted in start_pool!/2): 'Result: 4/5 passed', T4 failed; tree restored via git checkout. (d) Mutant M2b (guard moved after create_slots, init guard also removed so it is not masked): 'Result: 3/5 passed', T4 and T5 failed; tree restored. (e) mix format --check-formatted exit 0. (f) git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD lists only expected files (issue record, handoffs, design doc paragraph, pool test, test spec, tenant_fixture.ex). (g) git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD clean (tree ce3e39795e2a076e5eae75424239a4b872ea1d91, no conflicts). Acceptance: (1) guard runs after Sandbox.mode(:auto) and before GenServer.start/create_slots, raising ArgumentError; (2) T2/T3 assert refusal on name mismatch; (3) mutation makes T4 fail; (4) fixture diff is purely additive, reset path untouched. Note: full-suite test_parallel.sh and mix letflow.check.test were not run as this is a test-support-only issue fix and the handoff scoped the checks.
